description: Matched electron problems for the code-to-code comparison of #150 (docs/validation.md, 'Electron oracles: Nebula and Geant4 MicroElec'): electrons at normal incidence into bulk Si and bulk Cu at 1, 5 and 20 keV. Read by validation/oracles/run_electron.py. The material parameters (optical ELF, band structure) are not stored here: both lindhard and Nebula read them at run time from the user's cstool clone (CSTOOL_SRC), so nothing of them enters this tree.

metrics.eta: backscatter yield: electrons leaving the front face with E >= 50 eV (vacuum energy) per primary
metrics.delta: secondary yield: electrons leaving the front face with E < 50 eV per primary
metrics.primary_depth_nm: mean depth (along the beam) at which the primaries that stopped in the target came to rest
metrics.r50_nm: radius about the beam axis of the cylinder that contains 50 % of the energy deposited in the target (over all depths)

tolerances.source: #150 acceptance criteria (operator, 2026-10-07): initial tolerances vs Nebula, the closest model. Loosening needs operator sign-off.
tolerances.report_only: delta, primary_depth_nm, every 1 keV result, and every Geant4 MicroElec result are reported without pass/fail
